text:
No, Plant Club plants are a surprise, so you can't choose a specific one, including a rare calathea. Collector boxes ($49/month) do include a medium or rare plant in a 6-inch pot, matched to your light level, so a rare plant is possible but not guaranteed to be a calathea. You can list up to 3 plants you already own so you don't get duplicates.

If you'd like to pick a specific plant, I don't have information in my policy excerpts about buying one individually, but I can escalate that question to a Support Lead if you'd like.
